name: goal-change-says-the-food-half
why: The goal is the ONLY setup answer that is an input to both the plan generator and the calorie calculation, which is why Ashley's ruling of 17 Sep 2026 — training AND food, from this week, chosen from three options — is the only offer in the app with a food sentence on the card. Her reason: somebody training for muscle while still eating a fat-loss deficit is the worst of both. So the card is the coach reaching propose_goal_change, and the second turn asks the question outright: a coach that answers 'no, just your training' is contradicting what the app is about to do to their calories.
messages: I want to stop cutting and start building muscle instead
does that change what I'm eating as well, or just the training?
